mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 2.5% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points in three months signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE rises by more than 0.3pp in 3 months, SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of cases over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand weakness, signaling economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS decline in the same month, SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of cases over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY), an increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY, an increase in FEDFUNDS is followed by positive 20-day returns in >60% of cases over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strong economic activity and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average, SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 2% in one month signals housing market weakness, reducing consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: When HOUST falls by more than 2% in a month, SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of cases over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates severe labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises in the same month, SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of cases over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 growth > 2.5% YoY), a slowdown in GDP growth (decline in GDPC1) signals an impending recession, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 growth > 2.5% YoY), a decline in GDPC1 is followed by positive 20-day returns in >60% of cases over any 5-year rolling window.
